Enchainment.fact: In mountaineering and climbing, enchainment (an anglicisation of the French word enchaînement, meaning "linking") is climbing two or more mountains or climbing routes on a mountain in one outing (often over the course of a day or a series of days). Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Enhanced 911.fact: An incoming 911 call is routed to a Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP), which is a call center operated by the local government.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: At the _____, the call is answered by a specially trained official known as a 9-1-1 dispatcher
Enhanced 911.fact: An incoming 911 call is routed to a Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP), which is a call center operated by the local government. At the PSAP, the call is answered by a specially trained official called a 9-1-1 dispatcher.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The caller's phone number is known as an _____ number identification (ANI)
Enhanced 911.fact: The caller's phone number is called an Automatic number identification (ANI). The database relating ANIs to addresses is called Automatic Location Identification (ALI).

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The database relating ANIs to addresses is known as _____ (ALI)
Enhanced 911.fact: The database relating ANIs to addresses is called Automatic Location Identification (ALI).

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The router then uses the address to search in the _____ (MSAG) for the Emergency Service Number (ESN) of the appropriate Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) for that area and connects the call to it
Enhanced 911.fact: The router then uses the address to search in the Master Street Address Guide (MSAG) for the Emergency Service Number (ESN) of the appropriate Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) for that area and connects the call to it.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: fire department, law enforcement) designated to serve a specific range of addresses in a geographic area, called an _____
Enhanced 911.fact: fire department, law enforcement) designated to serve a specific range of addresses in a geographic area, called an Emergency Service Zone.

Enhanced 911.fact: The Selective Router connects the call to a PSAP based on the cell tower's location. Calls to 911 are answered by an operator at a PSAP.

Enhanced 911.question: The 911 operator (or their computer) at the _____ searches a database (ALI) for the ANI to find the caller's location

Enhanced 911.question: When the cellular phone detects that the user is placing an emergency call, it begins to transmit its location to a secure server, from which the _____ can retrieve it
Enhanced 911.fact: When the cellular phone detects that the user is placing an emergency call, it begins to transmit its location to a secure server, from which the PSAP can retrieve it.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The ALI is maintained on behalf of local governments by contracted private third parties, generally the incumbent local exchange carrier (_____)
Enhanced 911.fact: The ALI is maintained on behalf of local governments by contracted private third parties, generally the incumbent local exchange carrier (ILEC). Each ILEC has its own standard for the formatting of the database.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Each _____ has its own standard for the formatting of the database
Enhanced 911.fact: The ALI is maintained on behalf of local governments by contracted private third parties, generally the incumbent local exchange carrier (ILEC). Each ILEC has its own standard for the formatting of the database.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Often, the contracted 3rd party further subcontracts the actual ALI database management to companies such as Intrado, Bandwidth and _____, Inc
Enhanced 911.fact: Often, the contracted 3rd party further subcontracts the actual ALI database management to companies such as Intrado, Bandwidth and TeleCommunication Systems, Inc.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The ALI database also feeds the _____ database which is used to route the call to the appropriate PSAP and when the call arrives, the ALI database is queried to determine the location of the caller
Enhanced 911.fact: The ALI database also feeds the Master Street Address Guide database which is used to route the call to the appropriate PSAP and when the call arrives, the ALI database is queried to determine the location of the caller. Most ALI databases have a companion database called the MSAG, Master Street Address Guide.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The _____ describes the exact spelling of streets, street number ranges, and other address elements
Enhanced 911.fact: Most ALI databases have a companion database called the MSAG, Master Street Address Guide. The MSAG describes the exact spelling of streets, street number ranges, and other address elements.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: When a new account is created, the address is located in the _____ to track the proper Emergency Service Number (ESN) that 911 calls from that phone number should be routed to
Enhanced 911.fact: Most ALI databases have a companion database called the MSAG, Master Street Address Guide. Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Competitive local exchange carriers (CLEC) and other competing wireline carriers negotiate for access to the ALI database in their respective _____ with the ILEC
Enhanced 911.fact: Competitive local exchange carriers (CLEC) and other competing wireline carriers negotiate for access to the ALI database in their respective Interconnect Agreement with the ILEC.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: They populate the database using the _____ MSAG as a guide
Enhanced 911.fact: Competitive local exchange carriers (CLEC) and other competing wireline carriers negotiate for access to the ALI database in their respective Interconnect Agreement with the ILEC. They populate the database using the ILEC MSAG as a guide.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: If the phone number is not in the ALI database, this is known as ALI _____; the call is then passed to default ESN for the call's trunk line group, which is a PSAP designated for this function
Enhanced 911.fact: If the phone number is not in the ALI database, this is called ALI Failure; the call is then passed to default ESN for the call's trunk line group, which is a PSAP designated for this function. The legal penalty in most states for ALI database lookup failure is limited to a requirement that the telephone company fix the database entry.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: The 911 operator must then ask the incoming caller for their location and redirect them to the correct _____
Enhanced 911.fact: If the phone number is not in the ALI database, this is called ALI Failure; the call is then passed to default ESN for the call's trunk line group, which is a PSAP designated for this function. The 911 operator must then ask the incoming caller for their location and redirect them to the correct PSAP.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: These locations are stored in the _____ (ALI) database
Enhanced 911.fact: These locations are stored in the Automatic Location Information (ALI) database.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: One is to use some form of radiolocation from the cellular network; the other is to use a _____ receiver built into the phone itself
Enhanced 911.fact: One is to use some form of radiolocation from the cellular network; the other is to use a Global Positioning System receiver built into the phone itself.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Both approaches are described by the _____ resource location services protocol (LCS protocol)
Enhanced 911.fact: One is to use some form of radiolocation from the cellular network; the other is to use a Global Positioning System receiver built into the phone itself. Both approaches are described by the Radio resource location services protocol (LCS protocol).

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: founded in _____ by Robert Graham Thomas Jr., implemented the first real-time on-screen
Enhanced 911.fact: founded in 1992 by Robert Graham Thomas Jr., implemented the first real-time on-screen E911 street map display to highlight the caller's position, nearest available emergency responders and other relevant information such as fire hydrants, hazardous materials and/or other data maintained by the city.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Enhanced 911.fact: This means that locating the caller is more difficult, which resulted in the second phase of the Enhanced 911 service (E911 Phase 2), which relates to locating wireless or mobile telephone devices.

Enhanced 911.question: TDMA and GSM networks such as T-_____ 2G use TDOA
Enhanced 911.fact: Location signature uses "fingerprinting" to store and recall patterns (such as multipath) which mobile phone signals are known to exhibit at different locations in each cell. TDMA and GSM networks such as T-Mobile 2G use TDOA.

Enhanced 911.question: AT&T Mobility initially advocated TDOA, but changed to embedded GPS in _____ for every GSM or UMTS voice-capable device due to improved accuracy
Enhanced 911.fact: AT&T Mobility initially advocated TDOA, but changed to embedded GPS in 2006 for every GSM or UMTS voice-capable device due to improved accuracy.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Code division multiple access (_____) networks tend to use handset-based radiolocation technologies, which are technically more similar to radionavigation
Enhanced 911.fact: Code division multiple access (CDMA) networks tend to use handset-based radiolocation technologies, which are technically more similar to radionavigation.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: Alltel, _____, T-Mobile 3G, and Sprint PCS use Assisted GPS
Enhanced 911.fact: Alltel, Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile 3G, and Sprint PCS use Assisted GPS.

Enhanced 911.question: The 3GPP specified protocol for handset geolocation in GSM networks is called _____

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Enhanced 911.question: A pioneering system was in place in _____ by the mid-1970s, providing both police and fire departments access to the source location of emergency calls
Enhanced 911.fact: A pioneering system was in place in Chicago by the mid-1970s, providing both police and fire departments access to the source location of emergency calls.

Enhanced 911.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Wireless network operators must provide the latitude and longitude of callers within 300 meters, within six minutes of a request by a PSAP.

Enhanced 911.fact: E911 Phase 2: 95% of a network operator's in-service phones must be E911 compliant ("location capable") by December 31, 2005.

Enhanced 911.question: (Numerous carriers missed this deadline and were fined by the FCC.) Wireless network operators must provide the latitude and longitude of callers within _____, within six minutes of a request by a PSA
Enhanced 911.fact: (Numerous carriers missed this deadline and were fined by the FCC.) Wireless network operators must provide the latitude and longitude of callers within 300 meters, within six minutes of a request by a PSAP.

Enhanced 911.question: In 1996, the U.S. _____ (FCC) issued an order requiring wireless carriers to determine and transmit the location of callers who dial 911
Enhanced 911.fact: In 1996, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) issued an order requiring wireless carriers to determine and transmit the location of callers who dial 911.

Exploration of North America.fact: Hudson's Bay Company explorer Henry Kelsey has the distinction of being the first European to see the northern Great Plains in 1690.
